note: Cached moderation state stores each moderated entity's Content Moderation state in a hidden, indexable field named cached_moderation_state (field type cached_moderation_state, no_ui). FieldConfigHandler::sync() runs on install and on every workflow config save to create the field on moderated bundles and delete it from unmoderated ones - you never create the field manually; you enable caching for a bundle by adding it to a content_moderation workflow. Configure/back-fill via /admin/cached-moderation-state/update (permission access cached_moderation_state update_form) or drush cached-moderation-state:update-all/:update/:sync-fields/:list-moderated-bundles. Requires content_moderation+field, PHP 8.1+. Medium introspection has the agent find which bundle has the auto-installed field; hard execution has the agent moderate a bundle (cachedmod_page) so the field auto-installs, verified via field_config existence. Setup/reset build their own content_moderation workflows (cloned from editorial's states) to avoid touching shared config.

evals.prompt: What does the cached_moderation_state Drupal module add to a moderated entity, and what is the machine name of the field it uses? How do I read the value in code?
evals.expected_output: It adds a hidden, indexable field named cached_moderation_state (field type cached_moderation_state, no_ui) that caches the entity's Content Moderation state. Read it in code as $entity->cached_moderation_state->value (and ->updated for the timestamp).

evals.prompt: With the cached_moderation_state module installed, how does a content type get the cached field, and how do I populate the cached value for content that already existed?
evals.expected_output: The field is added automatically to any bundle you moderate with Content Moderation (FieldConfigHandler::sync() runs on install and on workflow save). Back-fill existing content with the batch form at /admin/cached-moderation-state/update or `drush cached-moderation-state:update-all` (or :update node:bundle).

evals.prompt: Which Drush commands does the cached_moderation_state module provide to back-fill cached values and to list which bundles are moderated?
evals.expected_output: cached-moderation-state:update <bundles>, cached-moderation-state:update-all, cached-moderation-state:list-moderated-bundles, and cached-moderation-state:sync-fields (with --batch-size and --only-uninitialized options on the update commands).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the cached_moderation_state module has automatically added its cached field to exactly one content-type bundle (the one that is under content moderation). Inspect the live site and give the machine name of that node bundle.
evals.expected_output: The bundle is cachedmod_known: node.cachedmod_known has a cached_moderation_state field instance (e.g. `drush cached-moderation-state:list-moderated-bundles` -> node:cachedmod_known, or list FieldConfig entities of field type cached_moderation_state).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a content type with machine name cachedmod_page that is not yet under content moderation, and a content_moderation workflow named cachedmod_wfp. Enable moderation-state caching for the cachedmod_page content type using the cached_moderation_state module, so that the module installs its cached field on that bundle. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add the node:cachedmod_page bundle to a Content Moderation workflow (e.g. cachedmod_wfp) and save it; cached_moderation_state's FieldConfigHandler::sync() then auto-creates the cached_moderation_state field instance on node.cachedmod_page (verified by that FieldConfig existing). Running `drush cached-moderation-state:sync-fields` after moderating the bundle also ensures the field.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the content type cachedmod_known2 is under content moderation and has one node. Inspect the live site and give the value of that node's cached_moderation_state field.
evals.expected_output: The node's cached_moderation_state value is 'draft' (read $node->cached_moderation_state->value for the node of type cachedmod_known2).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the content type cachedmod_sync is under content moderation, but its cached_moderation_state field instance is missing (out of sync). Using the cached_moderation_state module, restore the cached_moderation_state field instance for that moderated bundle. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Re-synchronise the field instances so node.cachedmod_sync has its cached_moderation_state FieldConfig again - e.g. `drush cached-moderation-state:sync-fields`, or re-save the workflow that moderates cachedmod_sync (which triggers FieldConfigHandler::sync()).
